sources.title: Darmm/darmm-text-generation-kazakh-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Darmm Kazakh v2 (Darmm/darmm-text-generation-kazakh-v2) is a significantly improved iteration of our Kazakh language model series. While v1 was built on synthetic data and mT5, v2 is built on organic, real-world data and the powerful Qwen 2.5 7B architecture.
